## Feature → scenario → requirements

### actions.feature (5 scenarios)

- A first sync writes both actions files in the documented envelope: JDL-033, JDL-034, JDL-040, JDL-041, JDL-042, JDL-043
- A later run on an earlier injected day finds the real-clock stamp fresh unless forced: JDL-043, JDL-091
- A stamp from an earlier UTC day refreshes, a second before midnight or not: JDL-091
- A stamp from the same UTC day skips the refresh and the stored splits are used: JDL-041, JDL-044, JDL-091, JDL-092
- Dividends are stored verbatim in date order and splits may be absent: JDL-034, JDL-042

### adjustment.feature (8 scenarios)

- A degenerate stored split ratio fails the leg before anything is written: JDL-052, JDL-101
- A split synced after the first fill re-derives every price but only re-raw-izes the tail's volume: JDL-049, JDL-054, JDL-065, JDL-069, JDL-097

- An EODHD crypto series is stored as served, end-guarded at the previous UTC day: JDL-053, JDL-055, JDL-094

- The adjust command re-derives the mains from raw with whatever splits are stored: JDL-041, JDL-049, JDL-069, JDL-139
- The adjust command refuses what it must not adjust: JDL-051, JDL-069, JDL-134, JDL-139
- The declared class, never the .CC suffix, decides basis, actions and guard: JDL-053, JDL-084, JDL-086, JDL-094
